column1: # Incremental ablation ladder for the sst-sat rerun.  Pipe-delimited (config_defines
# hold spaces).  Columns:  name | heap | config_defines | run_flags
#   name           builds/<name>/  (element library dir, select with --lib-dir)
#   heap           classic | pipelined   -> maps to make HEAP_IMPL (classic adds
#                  -DUSE_CLASSIC_HEAP; must be paired with --classic-heap at run)
#   config_defines -DKNOB=VAL... passed as make CONFIG_DEFINES (see src/structs.h)
#   run_flags      appended after `--` to run_slurm.sh / run_sc_l2.sh at run time
# Each rung is CUMULATIVE: it turns on one more feature vs. the rung above.
# Build all:  tools/build_configs.sh        Build some: tools/build_configs.sh baseline paraprop
# Baseline turns everything off: parallel counts = 1, no pre-watchers, no free
# list, classic heap, no prefetch.  'learn' (empty defines) == the full/final
# master config (all knobs at their structs.h defaults, pipelined, prefetch).
# name        | heap      | config_defines                                                                                              | run_flags
baseline      | classic   | -DPARA_LITS=1 -DPROPAGATORS=1 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=1 -DMINIMIZERS=1 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=0 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=0 | --classic-heap
paraprop      | classic   | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=1 -DMINIMIZERS=1 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=0 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=0 | --classic-heap
heap          | pipelined | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=8 -DMINIMIZERS=1 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=0 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=0 |
prewatch-fl   | pipelined | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=8 -DMINIMIZERS=1 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=7 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=1 |
prefetch      | pipelined | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=8 -DMINIMIZERS=1 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=7 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=1 | --prefetch
min           | pipelined | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=8 -DMINIMIZERS=4 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=1 -DPRE_WATCHERS=7 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=1 | --prefetch
reducer       | pipelined | -DPARA_LITS=8 -DPROPAGATORS=7 -DLEARNERS=1 -DHEAPLANES=8 -DMINIMIZERS=4 -DREDUCE_WORKERS=16 -DPRE_WATCHERS=7 -DUSE_FREE_LIST=1 | --prefetch
learn         | pipelined |                                                                                                             | --prefetch
